# Winifred Tolley

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old in Volume 1, around fifty-seven by Volume 2.  <sub>[v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 c15 P21](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0021), [v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive; married to Ambrose Kerr.  <sub>[v2 c25 P8](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley / Seven Gulls, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002), [v2 c6 P4](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0004), [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and active community member  <sub>[v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028), [v2 c25 P25](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0025)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Winifred Tolley  <sub>[v2 c6 P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037)</sub>; Miss Winifred  <sub>[v2 c6 P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037)</sub>; Mrs. Ambrose Kerr; Mrs. Kerr  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>

## Appearance

Winifred is a tall, stout woman with a determined mouth, dark eyes, and dark hair that eventually turns gray. She possesses a remarkably healthy, rosy-and-white complexion and cheerful brown eyes behind steel-framed spectacles. On occasion, she wears a blue-and-white striped apron over a chocolate print wrapper adorned with pink roses, and a white leghorn hat with ostrich plumes.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v2 c6 P15](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0015), [v2 c21 P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020)_

## Personality

Winifred is exceptionally outspoken, firm, and candid, possessing the most venomous tongue and the most compassionate heart in Seven Gulls. She is extremely practical, energetic, and clean, holding a deep disdain for laziness, Methodists, and men in general, though she frequently helps those in need. Despite her severe manner, she has a lively sense of humor and a genuine affection for young people.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v2 c6 P15](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0015), [v2 c6 P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037), [v2 c6 P40](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0040), [v2 c25 P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v4 c8 P23](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0023)_

## Goals

- To assist the poor, sick, and needy in the community  <sub>[v2 c6 P40](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0040), [v2 c8 P23](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0023), [v4 c8 P23](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0023)</sub>
- To reform and guide the orphan Mary Stubbs  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P13](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0013)</sub>
- To preserve Presbyterian propriety and community order  <sub>[v2 c8 P40](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0040), [v2 c14 P57](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0057)</sub>

## History

Miss Winifred Tolley resides near Seven Gulls on St. Brendan's Island. She first becomes acquainted with Nell Harcourt when Nell visits Pear Hill with Thirza Abernethy, offering her pattern patterns and interacting with the children. Over the years, Winifred becomes a trusted neighbor and advisor to Nell and the local youth. When the orphan Mary Stubbs runs away from her abusive guardian, Winifred takes her into her own home to raise and instruct her. Late in life, after two decades of courting, Winifred agrees to marry Ambrose Kerr after he finally shaves his long beard upon a Liberal political victory. Following her marriage, she moves with Ambrose into her house and remains deeply involved in church affairs, the Brierley Village Improvement Society, and caring for local families, including the motherless children of the manse.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v2 c6 P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037), [v2 c25 P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v4 c35 P8](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0008), [v5 c2 P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Pembroke, sister of Isolde's father  <sub>[v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- Had many suitors during her youth but chose not to marry until much later in life  <sub>[v2 c6 P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037), [v3 c35 P22](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0022)</sub>
- Raised near Seven Gulls and resided on the coastal/Stonebridge road  <sub>[v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v2 c6 P4](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0004)</sub>

> Doing a good deed for someone else is never wasted, take MY word for it.  <sub>[v2 c6 P40](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0040)</sub>
